remarks: Welcome to this spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo, offering a generous 1,524 sq ft of potential in Cos Cob. This one-level unit features an attached garage for convenient parking and additional storage w/ direct access. The condo boasts sliders that lead to a private patio, providing an ideal spot for outdoor enjoyment. Both bedrooms are well-sized, offering ample closet space, while the two bathrooms present an opportunity for a fresh, modern redesign. Additionally, there is a dedicated office space, perfect for remote work or as a cozy reading nook. This condo presents a blank canvas for your creative vision. Don't miss the chance to make this space your own! Seconds to the Bible Street Playground, a half mile to Cos Cob School, & less than a mile to shops and restaurants nearby too.
